title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, a young inventor who carries on her work of recording stories on Thunder Junction and uses drones to steal an elixir from Obeka.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, a planeswalker who recorded history and was killed after being compleated; her memories survive as an animated story scroll.

entities.name: Obeka
entities.description: A blue-gray ogre time mage and Slickshot mercenary who guards the elixir with an illusion and sends Nashi back into his memories.

entities.name: Lilah
entities.description: A Slickshot boss who possesses the magic amplifier.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: A planeswalker with whom Nashi has a complicated relationship, and who Nashi believes did not listen to him.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The figure who killed what was left of Tamiyo with her sword.

entities.name: Slickshots
entities.description: A criminal organization that operates from the Voyager Grande, whose members like flashy duels.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: An outlaw gang suspected of wanting the amplifier.

entities.name: Outcasters
entities.description: Wild magic users recorded on Nashi's drones.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A powerful company whose guards patrol the cities.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The head of the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Ironstone
entities.description: A run-down roadside town with a card den, abandoned mine and a rail station.

entities.name: The Voyager Grande
entities.description: A tall entertainment megaplex and hotel that hides the Slickshot headquarters.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: A city that offers high-collar marks for thieves.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Wild West plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals between planes through which travelers and reunited families arrive.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion of the Multiverse that cost Nashi his mother.

entities.name: Story magic
entities.description: Tamiyo's magic of reciting stories from scrolls, which Nashi struggles to control.

entities.name: The magic amplifier
entities.description: A metallic red potion that enhances a user's magic, held by Lilah and Obeka.

entities.name: Nashi's drones
entities.description: Nashi's small camera drones, which can record and replay magic.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane mentioned in rumor about Halo.

events.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
events.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

events.summary: Nashi practices story magic in the cactus forest with the memory of his mother, but falters when grief breaks his focus.
events.quote: Nashi faltered, and the sprout gave a weakened shudder before coiling back into the sand.

events.summary: Nashi watches drone footage from the Ironstone train station and recalls a family reunion at an Omenpath, stirring grief for his mother.
events.quote: A part of him knew it was unfair to blame the Wanderer for taking away the reunion he might've had with his mother

events.summary: Nashi overhears two Slickshots discussing Lilah's magic amplifier and learns of its existence.
events.quote: There was an amplifier on Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Nashi infiltrates the Voyager Grande and uses a drone to open a locked room on the tenth floor.
events.quote: Its metal legs reached into the keyhole, and Nashi heard the click from outside.

events.summary: Nashi's hand passes through the bottle, then the room shatters and Obeka appears.
events.quote: there was an ogre with blue-gray skin and a ferocious glare.

events.summary: Nashi's drone snatches the elixir but Obeka pulls it back with her time magic.
events.quote: a chain of golden links thrashed forward, tugging at the air as if it were pulling the drone back through time.

events.summary: Nashi tries an invisibility story spell but it falters, and Obeka derides his weakness.
events.quote: The elixir doesn't give power, it enhances it—and you clearly have nothing worth strengthening.

events.summary: Obeka punches Nashi and her magic flings him back through his own memories.
events.quote: until the explosion shattered his reality.

events.summary: Nashi relives a memory in which young Nashi, with a homemade bird gadget, is told by Tamiyo not to hide who he is.
events.quote: You are Nashi . That is who I'm proud of.

events.summary: Nashi wakes to find Obeka and the amplifier gone, and decides to use drones instead of story scrolls.
events.quote: Obeka hadn't meant to, but she'd done him a favor.

events.summary: Nashi realizes he is not so different from his mother, and finds his magic flows naturally when he loads recordings onto drones.
events.quote: Magic bristled at his fingertips, more naturally than ever before.

events.summary: Nashi returns to Obeka's office, invisible, and shows her the drone footage.
events.quote: Not until he let the invisibility spell drift away.

events.summary: Nashi steals the elixir with a copied time illusion, leaving Obeka lunging at an illusion, and escapes over the roof.
events.quote: she lunged for Nashi before crashing straight through him and onto the floor.

events.summary: Tamiyo's voice congratulates Nashi, who celebrates and plans to make her proud.
events.quote: "You did it," came Tamiyo's voice in a whisper.

relations.quote: We are family. You are my son.

relations.note: The Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo after her compleation.
relations.quote: the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo

relations.note: Obeka is a hired mercenary working for the Slickshots.
relations.quote: information on the Slickshot's hired mercenaries
in the possession of a Slickshot boss called Lilah.

relations.note: Nashi says his relationship with Kaito is complicated.
Nashi steals the elixir from Obeka after she knocks him out.
relations.quote: "I'm not much of a storyteller—but I know how to work a camera."
